method: Counts only. Each company string is downloaded whole; the response must contain every record it reports. Records are counted by the first seven characters of date_received (the date the CFPB received the complaint, as in the database's CSV export). Months with no complaints count as zero. A missing category value is counted as "(not given)". Category names are the database's own; the product names changed during the window and are not merged. monthlyByIssue lists only non-zero cells. No narrative, ZIP code, tag, complaint ID or other free text is stored.
